activity.body: Changes recorded for this farm. Sign-in attempts are not listed here.
activity.title: Who changed what
app.name: Gavran
app.phaseNote: Here you write jobs, feed on hand, flocks, egg counts, and incubators. Season lists start empty. Market prices stay empty until you type them. Buyer notes are not sent as bills. Spending has no tax and no profit sum. Feed value, target heat, and medicine amounts are not filled in.
app.tagline: Farm records for Gavran and desi poultry
auth.bootstrapClosed: The first account has already been created. Ask an owner for an invitation.
auth.deactivated: This account is deactivated. Ask an owner to restore it.
auth.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.invalid: Those sign-in details are not correct.
auth.mobileHint: Ten digits. Example 9876543210. Spaces are ignored.
auth.ownerBody: Use the mail address and the long secret phrase for the owner.
auth.passwordChanged: Password updated. Other sessions were signed out.
auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A long passphrase is better than a short complex password.
auth.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait and try again.
auth.registerBody: This screen is available only while the system has no users. After that, people join by invitation.
auth.signInBody: A worker uses a mobile number and a PIN. The owner uses a mail address and a long secret phrase.
auth.workerBody: Type the mobile number and the PIN the owner gave you.
batches.birdTypeHint: A name you use on this farm, such as the kind of bird you keep. This is not a veterinary classification.
batches.birdsRemain: Close the batch only when the live count is zero.
batches.body: A group of birds that started together. The hatch day, if you know it, must be on or before the day you opened the flock.
batches.capacity: That shed does not have room for this count.
batches.closeBody: Close this batch only because the live count is zero. History stays.
batches.countHint: How many live birds you placed. Example: 45.
batches.emptyBody: Add a bird type name, then place the first birds in an active shed.
batches.fromRangeInstead: These birds are on a range area, not in a shed
batches.hatchHint: Date the chicks hatched or were born. It must be on or before Opened on. Leave blank if you do not know it. On the medicine paper, this date is day 1.
batches.inactiveShed: Birds can be placed only in an active shed.
batches.insufficient: That shed does not have that many birds in this batch.
batches.ledgerNote: Type the bird name yourself. This page does not keep a list of breeds. A bird move does not store a price or a medicine.
batches.needType: Save a bird type before creating a batch.
batches.noPrice: A sale records only the number of birds. The price is not stored in this phase.
batches.noneHere: No birds from this batch are in a shed.
batches.openedHint: The day this flock started on the farm. It cannot be after today.
batches.rangeBody: Name a place that is not a shed. Nothing is listed until you type it.
batches.sexBody: The ratio is these two numbers. There is no recommended ratio.
batches.sexEmpty: No rooster and hen counts yet.
batches.strainHint: Type a strain if you use one. No list is built in.
batches.title: Flocks
common.permissionDenied: You do not have permission for that.
dash.alert.care_overdue: {{count}} vaccine or medicine days have passed
dash.alert.eggs_missing: Today's eggs are not written yet
dash.alert.low_stock: {{count}} feed items are under the number you set
dash.alertDenied: This browser blocked notices. Allow them in the site settings, or read the coloured band on this page.
dash.alertEmpty: On. Nothing is due, so there is no notice to show. The coloured band stays quiet when the list is empty.
dash.alertFailed: The notice did not open. Read the coloured band on this page.
dash.alertInsecure: This address is not a secure page, so a phone cannot show a notice. On this computer, open the address that starts with 127.0.0.1. On the phone, set HTTPS=1, start again, and open the https address. Until then, read the coloured band on this page.
dash.alertOn: On. This browser can show today's list. It does not send a notice overnight.
dash.alertUnsupported: This browser cannot show a notice. Read the coloured band on this page.
dash.att.candling_not_set: {{count}} sets have not been looked at
dash.att.payments_not_set: Money still owed is not set
dash.att.schedule_not_checked: The chick-day paper is not checked yet
dash.noCare: No vaccine or medicine day is set yet.
dash.noMedicine: No medicine is written for today.
dash.sexMissing: {{count}} flocks have no rooster and hen count yet
dash.title: Today on the farm
documents.body: Store a photo or a PDF the farm keeps. A scan is not claimed, and how long the file is kept is not chosen.
documents.emptyBody: A file appears here after someone stores one.
documents.invalid: Use a JPEG, PNG, WebP, or PDF.
documents.retention: How long files are kept is not chosen yet.
documents.scan: This page does not check the file for you.
documents.title: Papers and photos
doses.amountFrom: The amount is written on page {{page}}.
doses.approveHint: Read the paper with your vet, then write a short note. Until you do, nobody can tick a line.
doses.hatchIsDayOne: The hatch date is day 1 on this paper. The age on the home card counts days since that date.
doses.needHatch: Write a hatch date to see today's line.
doses.noneThisDay: Nothing is written for this day.
doses.paperUnchecked: This paper is not checked yet.
doses.title: Medicine days
documents.tooLarge: That file is larger than 5 MB.
eggs.backyard: Batch and shed can stay blank. That fits a backyard or free-range collection.
eggs.body: Write how many eggs you collected. Counts are eggs, not weight, and no price is stored.
eggs.emptyBody: Name the sorts you use. Fertile and table are the two this farm named. Add them, rename the saved name, or type a different sort.
eggs.emptyCollectionsBody: Record today's eggs after you have at least one sort.
eggs.noPrice: This page stores how many eggs you collected. It does not store a price.
eggs.title: Eggs
expenses.alreadyReversed: That row already has a reversing entry.
expenses.body: Amounts you type. A correction is a new reversing row. The first row stays as it was.
expenses.categoriesEmptyBody: A category exists only after you name it. None are filled in.
expenses.counterparty: Who was paid or paid you
expenses.duplicate: That category name is already used.
expenses.needCategory: Name a category before an amount.
expenses.noBasis: This page does not work out profit. It does not add tax.
expenses.reverseNote: Why this reverses the earlier row
expenses.reversed: A reversing row was added. This row stays.
expenses.reverses: This row reverses an earlier one.
expenses.title: Money in and out
farm.codeHint: Short code, letters, numbers, and hyphens. Stored in uppercase.
farm.conflict: This record was changed by someone else. Reload and try again.
farm.createBody: Write the farm name. The units and the clock wait for you to confirm them.
farm.duplicateCode: That code or name is already used.
farm.name: Farm name
farm.notFound: That farm was not found, or you are not a member.
farm.profileBody: Identity, contact, and the units this farm will use.
farm.stepPeopleTodo: Invite the people who work on the farm.
farm.unitsNote: Weight and volume units are waiting for you to confirm them. This page does not store prices, tax, or medicine days.
farms.emptyBody: Create the farm record, then add sheds and people.
farms.noAccessBody: An owner must grant you access before you can see farm records.
farms.subtitle: Farms you belong to.
farms.title: Farms
fieldHint.addressLine: Village and street, if you want them stored. Example: Aare, Kolhapur.
fieldHint.att-date: The day they came. It cannot be after today.
fieldHint.att-note: Anything else. Example: left at noon for the market. You can leave this blank.
fieldHint.att-person: Who came. A worker can write only their own row.
fieldHint.batch-code: A short name you will recognize. Example: B2. It must differ from every other flock on this farm.
fieldHint.batch-shed: The shed these birds start in. Add a shed under Farm setup if the list is empty.
fieldHint.batch-source: Where the birds came from, in your words. Example: bought at the Kolhapur market. You can leave this blank.
fieldHint.batch-type: Which kind of bird. If the list is empty, add a kind in the box above.
fieldHint.bill-amount: The amount the shop wrote. Example: 1800. Nothing is calculated from it.
fieldHint.bill-date: The day on the shop slip. It cannot be after today.
fieldHint.bill-ref: The slip number, if there is one. You can leave this blank.
fieldHint.bill-supplier: Which shop wrote the amount. This is not posted to an account.
fieldHint.bio-body: The step in your own words. Example: foot dip at the yard gate.
fieldHint.candle-count: How many eggs matched that word. Example: 6.
fieldHint.candle-date: The day you looked through the eggs. It cannot be after today.
fieldHint.candle-label: A word for what you saw. Example: clear, or growing. You choose the word.
fieldHint.candle-notes: Anything else about the look. You can leave this blank.
fieldHint.code: A short farm code. Example: HOME. Letters and digits, no spaces.
fieldHint.contactEmail: An address for that person. You can leave this blank.
fieldHint.contactName: A person to ask for, if you want one stored. You can leave this blank.
fieldHint.contactPhone: A mobile number for that person. You can leave this blank.
fieldHint.currentPassword: Type the secret you use now, so we know it is you.
fieldHint.customer-name: Who buys from you. Example: Meera Kulkarni. The name must be unique on this farm.
fieldHint.customer-notes: How you know them. Example: takes 30 eggs every Sunday. You can leave this blank.
fieldHint.customer-phone: A mobile number, if you want to call them. You can leave this blank.
fieldHint.displayName: The name people on the farm will see. Example: Asha More.
fieldHint.doc-file: A photo or PDF, at most 5 MB. JPEG, PNG, WebP, or PDF.
fieldHint.doc-note: What this paper is. Example: shed photo after the rain.
fieldHint.done: What you finished, if you want it written. You can leave this blank.
fieldHint.egg-batch: The flock, if you know it. Leave none if the eggs came from mixed nests.
fieldHint.egg-count: How many eggs of this sort. Example: 18. Leave blank or 0 to skip this sort.
fieldHint.egg-date: The day you collected them. It cannot be after today.
fieldHint.egg-notes: Anything else. Example: one cracked, not counted. You can leave this blank.
fieldHint.egg-shed: The shed, if you know it. You can leave this as none.
fieldHint.egg-shift: Morning or evening, if you collect twice. Example: Morning. You can leave this blank.
fieldHint.egg-sort: A name you use for a kind of egg. Example: Hatching eggs.
fieldHint.email: The address you use to open your account. Example: asha@example.com.
fieldHint.expense-amount: The amount you type. Example: 450. Nothing is suggested.
fieldHint.expense-batch: The flock this money belongs with, if you know it. You can leave none.
fieldHint.expense-category: A name you use for a kind of money, such as feed or medicine. The list starts empty.
fieldHint.expense-category-id: Which money name this row uses. Add a name above if the list is empty.
fieldHint.expense-date: The day the money moved. It cannot be after today.
fieldHint.expense-direction: Money out is something you paid. Money in is something you received. No profit is calculated.
fieldHint.expense-notes: More words if you need them. You can leave this blank.
fieldHint.expense-ref: A slip number or words you will recognize later. You can leave this blank.
fieldHint.expense-unit: The money name you use. Example: INR. This is not a tax rule.
fieldHint.expense-who: Who paid or who received, if you want that remembered. Example: Ramesh feed shop.
fieldHint.from: The first day for this run. Typed now, not stored as a clock. It cannot be after today.
fieldHint.gr-bad: How much you refused. Example: 2. Use 0 if none.
fieldHint.gr-date: The day it arrived. It cannot be after today.
fieldHint.gr-note: What was wrong, if anything. You can leave this blank.
fieldHint.gr-supplier: Which shop the load came from. Writing this does not change feed on hand.
fieldHint.gr-unit: The unit of those amounts. Example: kg.
fieldHint.hatch-code: A short name for the new chick flock, if live chicks are more than zero. Example: C1.
fieldHint.hatch-date: The day the chicks came out. It cannot be after today.
fieldHint.hatch-live: How many chicks were alive. A number above zero can open a new chick flock.
fieldHint.hatch-losses: How many chicks were dead at hatch. This is a count you type.
fieldHint.hatch-note: Anything else about the hatch. You can leave this blank.
fieldHint.hatch-other: Eggs that did not hatch, or anything else you counted. You can leave 0.
fieldHint.hatch-set: How many eggs were still in the set when you counted the hatch.
fieldHint.hatch-shed: The shed the live chicks start in.
fieldHint.hatch-type: The bird kind for that new flock.
fieldHint.inc-code: A short machine name. Example: I1.
fieldHint.inc-name: A longer machine name. Example: Small homemade box.
fieldHint.inc-notes: Anything else about the machine. You can leave this blank.
fieldHint.inv-customer: Who received the goods. Add the person under Sales if the list is empty.
fieldHint.inv-date: The day you handed the slip over. It cannot be after today. This slip is not posted to an account.
fieldHint.inv-desc: What you handed over. Example: table eggs.
fieldHint.inv-note: Anything else on the slip. You can leave this blank. The slip stays unposted.
fieldHint.inv-price-unit: The money name, only if you also type a price. Example: INR.
fieldHint.item-name: What you keep. Example: broken maize. The name must be unique on this farm.
fieldHint.item-notes: Where you keep it, or anything else. You can leave this blank.
fieldHint.item-reorder: A low amount you type yourself, if you want a reminder level. Leave blank for none. Nothing is suggested.
fieldHint.item-unit: The unit you count this thing in. Example: kg. On-hand is a sum of ins and outs in this unit.
fieldHint.locale: The language this farm starts in. You can still switch the screen language later.
fieldHint.loss-count: How many birds this note is about. Example: 1. This note alone does not change the flock count.
fieldHint.loss-date: The day you noticed. It cannot be after today.
fieldHint.loss-movement: Optional link to a death movement already written on a flock. Leave none if you have not written one.
fieldHint.loss-note: What you saw. Example: a dog came into the yard at dusk.
fieldHint.maint-date: The day you changed whether the machine is in use. It cannot be after today.
fieldHint.maint-notes: Why you changed it. Example: fan stopped. You can leave this blank.
fieldHint.maint-status: In use, or out of use. This does not set a temperature.
fieldHint.med-date: The day you gave it. It cannot be after today.
fieldHint.med-entry: A page the owner has already marked as checked. An unchecked page cannot be used here.
fieldHint.move-batch: The flock this quantity was for, if you know it.
fieldHint.move-count: How many birds this line is about. Example: 12.
fieldHint.move-date: The day it happened. It cannot be after today.
fieldHint.move-direction: In adds to what you have. Out takes away. Pick the direction that matches the line.
fieldHint.move-from-range: The named outdoor place they leave. This is not a shed.
fieldHint.move-item: Which stored thing this line is about.
fieldHint.move-qty: How much. Example: 5. Use the same unit you use for this thing.
fieldHint.move-reason: Optional words. Example: moved to the layer shed.
fieldHint.move-shed: The shed, if you know it.
fieldHint.move-to-range: The named outdoor place they enter.
fieldHint.move-type: What happened: moved shed, sold, died, culled, or another exit. A sale here is a bird count, not a price.
fieldHint.name: The farm name people will see. Example: Gavran Farm.
fieldHint.newPassword: A new secret, at least 10 characters. It replaces the one you use now.
fieldHint.note-body: The message. Example: The hens are still in the yard.
fieldHint.note-person: Who should read this. They see it inside the program. Nothing is sent outside.
fieldHint.note-title: A short subject. Example: Shut the gate.
fieldHint.notes: Anything else about this shed. You can leave this blank.
fieldHint.obs-date: The day you saw the bird. It cannot be after today.
fieldHint.obs-entry: Optional link to a page in the paper list. Linking does not mean the page is approved.
fieldHint.obs-notes: What you saw, in your words. Example: hen sitting apart, comb pale.
fieldHint.order-customer: Who this draft is for. The draft is not posted as a sale.
fieldHint.order-date: The day you wrote the draft. It cannot be after today.
fieldHint.order-description: What they asked for. Example: live hens.
fieldHint.order-price: A price only if you type one. Leave blank to store no price.
fieldHint.par-dam: The mother, in your words. Example: brown hen, white ear.
fieldHint.par-dam-batch: The mother's flock, if she is in one. You can leave none.
fieldHint.par-date: The day you wrote this parent note. It cannot be after today.
fieldHint.par-note: Anything else about the pairing. You can leave this blank.
fieldHint.par-offspring: The young flock, if it is already on the farm. You can leave none.
fieldHint.par-sire-batch: The father's flock, if he is in one. You can leave none.
fieldHint.password: At least 10 characters. It is stored scrambled, not as you typed it.
fieldHint.pay-date: The day you paid. It cannot be after today.
fieldHint.pay-supplier: Which shop you paid. This does not calculate what is still owed.
fieldHint.person-email: The address they use to open the account. Example: ravi@example.com.
fieldHint.person-mobile: Ten digits. Example 9876543210. Spaces are ignored.
fieldHint.person-name: The name this person will see. Example: Ravi Patil.
fieldHint.person-password: At least 10 characters. They use this to open the account. It is stored scrambled.
fieldHint.person-role: Owner sees everything. A manager does not change the farm profile or people. A worker does not see money or people.
fieldHint.po-date: The day you wrote the draft. A later day is allowed.
fieldHint.po-desc: What you plan to buy. Example: maize, 50 kg sack.
fieldHint.po-price-unit: The money name, only if you also type a price.
fieldHint.po-qty: How much you plan to buy. Example: 2.
fieldHint.po-supplier: Which shop this draft is for. A draft is not a received load.
fieldHint.price-amount: The amount you type. Example: 8. It is not a market quote.
fieldHint.price-date: The day this typed price starts. It cannot be after today.
fieldHint.price-item: What the price is for. Example: table eggs. Nothing is suggested.
fieldHint.price-unit: The money name. Example: INR per egg.
fieldHint.range-name: A name for an outdoor place. Example: Mango yard. It has no bird limit.
fieldHint.read-date: The day you read the machine. It cannot be after today.
fieldHint.read-notes: Anything else about this reading. You can leave this blank.
fieldHint.read-power: Whether the machine had power when you looked: on, off, or you did not check.
fieldHint.read-source: Where the number came from: the machine's own display, or a thermometer you held.
fieldHint.read-time: The clock time, if you know it. Example: 08:15. Nothing is suggested.
fieldHint.reading-unit: The unit of that number, such as C or percent. Required only when a number is typed.
fieldHint.reading-value: The number you read. Leave blank if you did not read it. No target is stored.
fieldHint.rename: A new name for this checklist. Example: Monsoon morning.
fieldHint.report-batch: Only rows for this flock, where the row has a flock. Leave all flocks to skip the filter.
fieldHint.report-category: Only egg rows of this sort. Leave all sorts to skip the filter.
fieldHint.report-from: The first day to include. It cannot be after today.
fieldHint.report-shed: Only rows for this shed, where the row has a shed. Leave all sheds to skip the filter.
fieldHint.report-to: The last day to include. It must be on or after the first day. It cannot be after today.
fieldHint.ret-date: The day the goods came back. It cannot be after today.
fieldHint.ret-desc: What came back. Example: 10 eating eggs.
fieldHint.ret-note: Why they came back. You can leave this blank.
fieldHint.ret-unit: The money name, only if you also type an amount. Example: INR.
fieldHint.reverse-date: The day you write this correcting row. The earlier row stays. It cannot be after today.
fieldHint.reverse-note: Why this row corrects the earlier one. Example: counted the same sack twice.
fieldHint.sch-date: The day you named it. A later day is allowed.
fieldHint.sch-name: A name you will recognize. Example: Sunday egg count.
fieldHint.sch-note: What this name is for. You can leave this blank. Nothing is sent out.
fieldHint.search-q: At least two characters. A percent sign is not a wildcard. Prices are not shown.
fieldHint.sex-date: The day you counted roosters and hens. It cannot be after today.
fieldHint.sex-hens: How many hens you counted. This does not change the live bird total.
fieldHint.sex-roosters: How many roosters you counted. This does not change the live bird total.
fieldHint.shed-code: A short shed name. Example: Y1. It must differ from every other shed here.
fieldHint.shed-name: A longer shed name. Example: Backyard layer house.
fieldHint.shed-type: What you use the shed for: chicks, growers, layers, breeders, a sick pen, storage, or other.
fieldHint.sit-code: A short name for this sitting. Example: S1.
fieldHint.sit-count: How many eggs you set. Example: 24.
fieldHint.sit-date: The day the eggs were set. It cannot be after today.
fieldHint.sit-hen: Which hen, in your words. Example: black hen with a white neck.
fieldHint.sit-machine: Which machine, if this sitting is not under a hen.
fieldHint.sit-mode: A machine, or a hen sitting on the eggs. No hatch day is calculated.
fieldHint.sit-notes: Anything else. You can leave this blank.
fieldHint.status: In use, not in use, or under repair. Birds are placed only in a shed that is in use.
fieldHint.step: One step, in your words. Example: check that drinkers have water. The list starts empty.
fieldHint.stock-move-date: The day the quantity changed. It cannot be after today.
fieldHint.stock-move-reason: Why. A correcting row needs a reason. Example: sack was short.
fieldHint.stock-move-type: Received, used, wasted, or a correcting row. A receipt here does not come from a shop order.
fieldHint.sup-contact: A person at that shop. You can leave this blank.
fieldHint.sup-name: The shop or person you buy from. Example: Patil feed store.
fieldHint.sup-notes: What you usually buy there. You can leave this blank.
fieldHint.sup-phone: A mobile number. You can leave this blank.
fieldHint.target-type: Which bird kind this typed target belongs to.
fieldHint.target-unit: Kilograms or grams, matching the number.
fieldHint.target-weight: A weight you type. Example: 1.2. Nothing is suggested, and it is not a growth standard.
fieldHint.task-assignee: Who should do it. Leave unassigned if anyone may do it.
fieldHint.task-due: The day it should be done. A later day is allowed.
fieldHint.task-instructions: How to do it, if the title is not enough. You can leave this blank.
fieldHint.task-note: What you did. Required only when the job asks for a note.
fieldHint.task-template: Copy steps from a checklist, if you have one. Leave none to write the job alone.
fieldHint.task-title: What the job is. Example: Shut the birds in.
fieldHint.timezone: The clock the farm uses for “today”. Example: Asia/Kolkata.
fieldHint.to: The last day for this run. It cannot be after today.
fieldHint.tr-body: The lesson in your words. There is no score.
fieldHint.tr-title: The name of the lesson. Example: How to shut the yard.
fieldHint.vaccine-due: The day the job should be done. A later day is allowed.
fieldHint.verify-note: Your own words that you checked this page against the paper. An amount is not filled in for you.
fieldHint.volumeUnit: The volume unit this farm types: litres or millilitres.
fieldHint.water-date: The day you noted the water. It cannot be after today.
fieldHint.water-notes: What you noticed. Example: drinkers were empty at noon. You can leave this blank.
fieldHint.water-qty: How much water, if you measured it. Leave blank if you only have a note.
fieldHint.water-source: Where the water came from. Example: well by the gate. You can leave this blank.
fieldHint.water-test: What a look or a lab note said, in your words. Example: clear, no smell. Nothing is interpreted.
fieldHint.water-unit: The unit of that amount, such as L. Required only when an amount is typed.
fieldHint.weigh-date: The day you weighed them. It cannot be after today.
fieldHint.weigh-unit: Grams or kilograms for that number.
fieldHint.weightUnit: The weight unit this farm types: kilograms or grams. It does not set a target weight.
fieldHint.yard-body: What happened, in your words. Example: all hens went out. One stayed on the nest.
fieldHint.yard-date: The day this happened. It cannot be after today.
fieldHint.yard-kind: Let out means the birds went into the yard. Shut in means they were closed for the night. A note is anything else.
fieldHint.yard-time: Optional clock time. Example: 06:30. No time is suggested.
fieldPh.batch-source: e.g. bought at the Kolhapur market
fieldPh.bio-body: e.g. foot dip at the yard gate
fieldPh.doc-note: e.g. shed photo after the rain
fieldPh.hatch-note: e.g. hatched under the black hen
fieldPh.inc-notes: e.g. kept in the store room
fieldPh.inv-note: e.g. handed over at the gate
fieldPh.loss-note: e.g. a dog came in at dusk
fieldPh.med-notes: e.g. mixed in the morning water
fieldPh.move-reason: e.g. moved to the layer shed
fieldPh.name: e.g. Gavran Farm
fieldPh.note-body: e.g. The hens are still in the yard
fieldPh.obs-notes: e.g. hen sitting apart, comb pale
fieldPh.reverse-note: e.g. counted the same sack twice
fieldPh.task-instructions: e.g. count them at the door
fieldPh.tr-body: e.g. close the east gate at dusk
fieldPh.tr-title: e.g. How to shut the yard
fieldPh.yard-body: e.g. All hens went out. One stayed on the nest.
hatch.differenceHint: Required only when live chicks, losses, and other eggs do not add up to the eggs set.
hatch.proposed: Only a suggestion: {{formula}} = {{percent}}. This is not a farm rule.
hatch.proposedNote: A hatch rate here is a suggestion: live chicks divided by eggs set. It is not a farm rule.
hatch.title: Hatches
hatch.tooMany: Those eggs are more than this sitting still has.
health.biosecurityNote: A step from the step-by-step PDF stays unapproved until you accept it. A step you type is yours.
health.body: Each disease and each medicine from the training papers is its own note. A vet or the owner must check it before anyone records that a medicine was given.
health.copyHint: The words stored are the PDF text layer for that page, not what you type here.
health.howToGive: How it was written to give
health.makeTask: Make a task from the note you approved
health.medicineNote: This stays blocked until that page is approved. Write what was done. The app does not fill in a dose or a withdrawal date.
health.title: Sick birds and medicines
health.verificationNote: Note from the owner or vet
health.verify: You or your vet must check a medicine page before you use it. An unchecked page cannot save a medicine or a vaccine job.
health.whatYouDidHint: Use the words from the approved note. Do not expect the app to supply a dose.
help.activity.how: Open the list and read the newest lines first.
help.activity.name: Who changed what
help.activity.what: A list of changes on this farm. Sign-in attempts are not in this list.
help.activity.where: Farm setup, then Who changed what.
help.activity.why: So you can see who added a flock or a payment.
help.batches.how: Save a bird name first. Then add a flock: a short code, the shed, how many birds, the day it opened, and the hatch day if you know it. The hatch day cannot be after the opened day. On the medicine paper that date is day 1. Tick a line when you have given it.
help.batches.name: Flocks
help.batches.what: A group of birds you started on one day, in one shed.
help.batches.why: So later eggs, deaths, and feed can point at the right birds.
help.body: Every screen: what it is, where it sits, why it exists, and how to use it. A worker signs in with a mobile number and a PIN. The owner uses a mail address. Hindi and Marathi on this page still need a fluent review.
help.documents.how: Choose a JPEG, PNG, WebP, or PDF under 5 MB and a short note.
help.documents.name: Papers and photos
help.documents.what: A photo or a PDF you keep, such as a bill photo or a bird photo.
help.documents.where: Farm setup, then Papers and photos. Workers do not see this.
help.documents.why: So a paper is next to the farm record. How long it is kept is not decided.
help.eggs.how: Add the sort names you use. Then record a day, optional flock and shed, and a count for each sort.
help.eggs.name: Eggs
help.eggs.what: How many eggs you collected, split by the names you use, such as eating eggs or hatching eggs.
help.eggs.where: Birds and eggs, then Eggs. Today also links here.
help.eggs.why: So you know what the hens gave each day. No price is stored.
help.expenses.how: Add a heading such as feed or medicine. Then write the day, in or out, the amount, and the unit.
help.expenses.name: Money in and out
help.expenses.what: Money you spent or received, with the unit you type, such as rupees.
help.expenses.where: Sales and money, then Money in and out.
help.expenses.why: So the farm notebook has a line for each amount. A correction is a new line. The old line stays.
help.health.how: Open a name. Read what it is for, the signs, how it was written to give, and the caution. Do not treat from an unchecked note.
help.health.name: Sick birds and medicines
help.health.what: Diseases and medicines copied from the Patil training papers, plus what you saw on the farm.
help.health.why: So a worker can read a named disease. A medicine note stays locked until the owner or a vet writes that they checked it.
help.home.how: Tap a tile. A tile with one job opens that job. A tile with many jobs opens those jobs.
help.home.name: Home
help.home.what: The first screen after you open a farm. Big tiles for the main jobs. A card lists today's medicine for each flock, morning and evening.
help.home.where: Tap the farm name on the farm list.
help.home.why: So you can see the whole farm without a long menu.
help.incubation.how: Start a sitting, choose machine or hen, and the day. Open it to candle or to write how many chicks came out.
help.incubation.name: Eggs set to hatch
help.incubation.what: A set of eggs under a machine or under a broody hen you name.
help.incubation.where: Incubator, then Eggs set to hatch.
help.incubation.why: Desi farms hatch with a hen or a machine. The program does not guess the hatch day.
help.incubators.how: Add the machine with a name you know. Open it to write a temperature or a repair, only if you measured it.
help.incubators.name: Incubator machines
help.incubators.what: The machines you own. A reading is only the numbers you type.
help.incubators.why: So temperature and care notes stay with the right machine. There is no target temperature built in.
help.invoices.how: Pick a customer and a day. Write what moved. Leave the price blank if you are not writing one. A return is a new line.
help.invoices.name: Buyer bills
help.invoices.what: A paper list of what a buyer took. It is not sent to a tax office, and no balance is worked out.
help.invoices.where: Sales and money, then Buyer bills.
help.invoices.why: So you can read back a sale. Posting into accounts is still not decided, so the line stays unposted.
help.losses.how: Write the day, what happened, and how many. You can point at a death already written on a flock.
help.losses.name: Birds lost
help.losses.what: A note of birds that died or were taken by an animal, in your own words.
help.losses.where: Birds and eggs, then Birds lost.
help.losses.why: So you remember what happened. No death rate is calculated.
help.notices.how: Choose the person, write a subject and a message, and save. They open Messages and mark it read.
help.notices.name: Messages
help.notices.what: A note from one person on the farm to another. It stays in this program.
help.notices.why: So a worker sees a message without a separate letter or a call from the program.
help.offline.how: When the internet is back, open this screen and tap Send. If the farm already has that row, it stays as a conflict and is not merged.
help.offline.name: Saved on this phone
help.offline.what: Attendance written while the internet was down. It waits here until you send it.
help.offline.where: Farm setup, then Saved on this phone.
help.offline.why: Only who-came-today can wait on the phone. Feed, money, deaths, and medicine are not stored offline.
help.parentage.how: Pick the young flock, write the father and mother in words, and optionally point at their flocks.
help.parentage.name: Parents
help.parentage.what: Which birds you believe are the father and mother of a flock.
help.parentage.why: Desi flocks are often bred at home. This only stores what you write. It does not suggest a pair.
help.people.how: For a worker, write the name, the mobile number, and a PIN of four to six digits, then tell them that PIN. A mail address and a long secret phrase remain for the owner and a manager. Owner sees everything. A worker sees daily jobs, birds, hatch, health, and feed.
help.people.name: People
help.people.what: Who may open this farm, and what they may change.
help.people.where: The People tile. A worker does not see this tile.
help.people.why: So each person has their own sign-in. Nothing is sent; you tell them the mobile number and the PIN yourself.
help.profile.how: Open the form. Change the name or the time zone, such as Asia/Kolkata, and save. A worker can read this but not change it.
help.profile.name: Farm details
help.profile.what: The farm name, place words, and whether you weigh in kilograms or grams.
help.profile.why: The clock of the farm decides which day is today for dates.
help.reports.how: Pick a start day and an end day. The end day cannot be after today. Optional filters narrow a shed, flock, or egg sort.
help.reports.name: Counts
help.reports.what: Totals for the dates you choose, such as eggs collected.
help.reports.why: So you can look back over a week or a month. A rate stays marked as proposed until you decide the formula.
help.saathi.how: Type or tap Speak. Read the card and change the flock, the number, or the day. Tap Save only when it is right. An egg or chick photo shows a count and boxes. Type your count, then confirm. A sick bird is matched only to the farm papers and labelled possible - confirm with vet.
help.saathi.name: Gavran Saathi
help.saathi.what: A helper that turns speech, typed words, or a photo into a card you can correct.
help.saathi.where: Daily work, then Gavran Saathi. The key is under Farm details.
help.saathi.why: So a count can be spoken in English, Hindi, or Marathi, and still checked before it is written.
help.safeguards.how: Read the open questions. Run the check only when you mean to test a restore on a separate practice database.
help.safeguards.name: Spare copy
help.safeguards.what: A check that a copy of the records can be opened on this computer. It is not a backup sitting somewhere else.
help.safeguards.where: Farm setup, then Spare copy. Only an owner or manager sees it.
help.safeguards.why: How long to keep records, and how much loss is acceptable, is still not chosen.
help.sales.how: Add a customer. Write a price when you want one. Then write an order with what left the farm.
help.sales.name: Sales
help.sales.what: Customers, what they ordered, and prices you type yourself.
help.sales.why: A local market price is only what you last wrote. Nothing is filled in.
help.schedules.how: Type a name, a note, and the day you named it. When you want numbers, type a start and end then.
help.schedules.name: Saved count names
help.schedules.what: A name you give to a count you run again later. Nothing runs by itself and nothing is sent.
help.schedules.where: Farm setup, then Saved count names.
help.schedules.why: So you remember a report you like, without a clock.
help.search.how: Type at least two letters. A percent sign is just a percent sign.
help.search.name: Find a record
help.search.what: Look for a name you typed, such as a flock code or a customer.
help.search.where: Farm setup, then Find a record.
help.search.why: A short way to jump to a record. Prices are not shown in the results.
help.sheds.how: Add a short code, a name, the kind of house, and a bird count you choose. That count is your limit, not a rule from a book.
help.sheds.name: Sheds
help.sheds.what: Houses and pens, with how many birds you say can stand there.
help.sheds.why: A new flock must start in a shed that is in use.
help.stock.how: Add an item in your own words, such as bajra or a mash you mix. Then write a quantity in or out.
help.stock.name: Feed and stock
help.stock.what: Feed, water, and weights you type. Nothing suggests a formula.
help.stock.why: So you see what came in and what the birds ate.
help.suppliers.how: Add the shop. Write an order, then what you accepted, then a bill or a payment if you want those lines.
help.suppliers.name: Shops you buy from
help.suppliers.what: People you buy feed or birds from, what you ordered, what arrived, and what you paid.
help.suppliers.where: Sales and money, then Shops you buy from.
help.suppliers.why: A delivery note does not add feed to stock by itself. You still write stock separately.
help.tasks.how: Add a job, pick a day, and optionally a person. The person marks it done and can write a note.
help.tasks.name: Jobs
help.tasks.what: Work you write down, with a day it should be done.
help.tasks.why: So people know what to do, including heat, rain, and cold lists you fill yourself.
help.title: Help
help.today.how: Read the jobs that are due. Tap a shortcut to write eggs, a loss, feed, who came, health, or the yard book.
help.today.name: Today
help.today.what: Jobs due today and shortcuts to eggs, losses, feed, who came, health, and the yard book.
help.today.where: Daily work, then Today. Also the sun icon on a phone.
help.today.why: So the morning starts in one place.
help.workforce.how: Pick the person and the day. Leave the clock blank if you do not use one. Training is lower on the same screen.
help.workforce.name: Who came to work
help.workforce.what: A note of who was on the farm, and training they finished.
help.workforce.where: Daily work, then Who came to work.
help.workforce.why: So you remember attendance without a score or a mark.
help.yard.how: Pick the day. Choose Let the birds out, Shut the birds in, or A note. Type a clock time if you know it, and a short line about what happened. Save the line.
help.yard.name: Yard book
help.yard.what: A notebook for the yard: when the birds went out, when they were shut in, and anything else you saw.
help.yard.where: Daily work, then Yard book. Today also links here.
help.yard.why: So the morning and the night have a written time, and a note stays with the farm.
home.body: Tap a tile. Each one is a job on the farm, not a technical menu.
incubation.body: A sitting is either an incubator or a named broody hen.
incubation.candlingHint: Type the outcomes you use. The counts must add up to the eggs you inspected. Nothing is scheduled.
incubation.capacity: That incubator does not have room for this egg count.
incubation.emptyBody: Name a broody hen, or choose an incubator that is in service.
incubation.noDate: This page does not pick a hatch day or a candle day. Write those dates yourself when you know them.
incubation.outOfService: That incubator is out of service.
incubation.title: Eggs set to hatch
incubators.body: Equipment on this farm. A reading stores only what you type.
incubators.capacityHint: A number you choose. It is not a stocking rule.
incubators.emptyBody: Add a machine when you have one. Broody hens are a separate record.
incubators.name: Name
incubators.noSetpoint: This page does not save a target heat or how damp it should be. Type the number you read, and the unit you use. Or leave it blank.
incubators.sensorNote: A sensor reading is not marked stale. No freshness rule is approved.
incubators.title: Incubator machines
install.ios: Use the share menu and add this screen to the home screen.
invoices.amountHint: Type an amount only if you want one on this return.
invoices.body: A list of what a buyer took. It is not sent to a tax office. No balance is worked out, and the line stays unposted.
invoices.emptyBody: Add one after you have a customer.
invoices.priceHint: Leave the price blank if you are not writing one.
invoices.title: Buyer bills
invoices.unposted: These notes are not sent as bills. The page does not work out what is still owed.
lang.label: Language
lang.provisional: Hindi and Marathi words still need a person who speaks them well to check the wording.
lang.reviewNote: Hindi and Marathi words still need a person who speaks them well to check the wording.
losses.body: Write what happened. There is no predator list.
losses.emptyBody: A note can stand on its own, or it can point at a mortality movement already on a batch.
losses.noRate: This page stores the birds you lost. It does not work out a loss rate.
losses.title: Birds lost
nav.group.birdsHint: Flocks, eggs, and birds that died
nav.group.dailyHint: Today, jobs, who came, and messages
nav.group.healthHint: Sick birds and medicines you have checked
nav.group.helpHint: What each screen is for, and a guided tour
nav.group.incubatorHint: Machines and eggs you are hatching
nav.group.moneyHint: What you sold, spent, and bought
nav.group.reportsHint: Numbers for the dates you choose
nav.group.settingsHint: Sheds, papers, and tools you rarely need
notices.body: Write a notice for someone on this farm. It stays in the app.
notices.emptyBody: A notice appears here after someone writes one for you.
notices.inApp: A notice stays in this app. Nothing is sent out. No urgent rule is stored.
notices.subject: Subject
notices.title: Messages
offline.body: Eggs, a medicine tick, a job, a loss, and who came today can wait on this device. They send themselves when the computer is reachable again. Feed, money, and medicine records do not wait.
offline.conflict: Conflict. The farm row was left as it was.
offline.decision: Eggs, medicine ticks, jobs, losses, and attendance can wait without a connection.
offline.emptyBody: A row saved without a connection appears here.
offline.held: This attendance row is waiting on this device.
offline.refused: Feed, spending, buyer notes, medicine records, and shop money are not stored on this device.
offline.title: Saved on this phone
parentage.body: Write the sire and the dam in your own words, or point at a batch. Nothing here suggests a pairing.
parentage.emptyBody: Add a note when you know a sire or a dam.
parentage.noRule: No pairing rule is stored. Write the parents you know.
parentage.parentHint: Type a name or a description. A batch link is optional.
parentage.title: Parents
people.body: Add a worker with a name, a mobile number, and a PIN. Tell them the PIN yourself. Nothing is sent. A mail address remains for the owner and for a manager who uses one.
people.deactivateBody: This signs them out of every farm. Their memberships stay so an owner can restore them.
people.emptyBody: Invite a manager, worker, family helper, or vet when you are ready.
people.grantsHint: Family helpers start with no access. Tick only what this person should see.
people.invited: Person added. Share the password with them directly. No message was sent.
people.lastOwner: This farm needs at least one active owner.
people.linked: Existing account linked. Their password was not changed, and no message was sent.
people.name: Name
people.pinResetSaved: PIN changed. The old PIN no longer works.
people.pinSaved: Person added. Tell them the mobile number and the PIN. Nothing was sent.
people.revokeBody: This removes their role on this farm. Their past activity stays in the record.
people.showMail: Add someone with a mail address
people.title: People
reports.body: Pick a start and end date. Each number says where it came from. A sum stays a suggestion until you confirm it.
reports.choose: Choose a start and end date.
reports.formula.attendance: Count of attendance rows in this range. This is not a score.
reports.formula.eggs: Sum of egg counts on collection lines in this range.
reports.formula.expenses: These are the amounts typed in this range. No profit is worked out.
reports.formula.hatches: Suggestion: live chicks divided by eggs set, times 100. This is not a farm rule.
reports.formula.invoiceDocuments: Buyer notes in this range. They are not sent as bills.
reports.formula.losses: Birds you wrote as lost in this range. No loss rate is worked out.
reports.formula.movements: These are the flock moves in this range. This is not a loss rate.
reports.formula.parentage: Parent notes in this range. No pairing rule is stored.
reports.formula.receipts: Accepted and rejected quantities. Feed on hand does not change.
reports.formula.returns: Return rows in this range. No amount still owed is worked out.
reports.hatchRow: {{live}} live chicks from {{eggs}} eggs set. Proposed {{percent}}%.
reports.notOfficial: These numbers are what you typed. The page does not work out feed used per bird.
reports.status.not_chosen: How to count money is not chosen
reports.title: Counts
saathi.age: {{range}}. That is an estimate, not a hatch date.
saathi.ask.date: Which day? Today, or a date.
saathi.ask.low: I am not sure. Check the number, then confirm.
saathi.ask.noDose: No medicine is due for that flock today.
saathi.ask.unclear: I did not catch that. Say the flock, the number, and the day.
saathi.body: Speak or type. Saathi shows a card. Nothing is written until you tap Save.
saathi.empty: Try “collected 12 eggs today” or “how do I use eggs”.
saathi.field.label: Medicine line
saathi.field.title: Job
saathi.help.eggs: Eggs: Daily work, then Eggs. Type the day and a count for each egg name. Nothing is priced.
saathi.help.expenses: Money in and out: type the day, the name, the amount, and the money unit.
saathi.help.hatch: Hatch: open the set of eggs, then write how many chicks came out. The hatch day is not guessed.
saathi.help.health: Health: open Sick birds and medicines. A tick on Today’s medicine records that the line was given. Unchecked notes cannot record a medicine.
saathi.help.losses: Birds lost: Daily work, then Birds lost. Type the day, the number, and a short note.
saathi.help.saathi: Saathi: Daily work, then Gavran Saathi. Speak or type. A card appears. Tap Save only when the flock, the number, and the day are right.
saathi.help.sales: Sales: Money, then Sales. Type the buyer, the count, and the price you choose.
saathi.help.stock: Feed: open Feed and stock. Type what was used and how much.
saathi.help.tasks: Jobs: Daily work, then Jobs. Type a title and a due day.
saathi.keyBody: The key stays on this computer, stored locked. The full key is not sent back to the phone.
saathi.keySaved: A key is stored. It ends in {{hint}}.
saathi.noAmount: The paper does not give an amount.
saathi.notInBook: That is not in the farm papers.
saathi.photo.needKey: Add a Gemini key in farm details to read a photo or a recording. Typed words still work.
saathi.say.dose: Medicine marked for {{batch}} on {{date}}. Tap Save when this is right.
saathi.say.eggs: {{count}} eggs for {{batch}} on {{date}}. Tap Save when this is right.
saathi.say.expense: {{count}} under {{batch}} on {{date}}. Type the money unit, then tap Save.
saathi.say.feed: {{count}} of {{batch}} used on {{date}}. Tap Save when this is right.
saathi.say.hatch: {{count}} chicks from {{batch}} on {{date}}. Tap Save when this is right.
saathi.say.loss: {{count}} birds lost from {{batch}} on {{date}}. Tap Save when this is right.
saathi.say.sale: {{count}} for {{batch}} on {{date}}. Tap Save when this is right.
saathi.say.task: Job “{{batch}}” due {{date}}. Tap Save when this is right.
saathi.title: Gavran Saathi
safeguards.backupBody: The check uses a separate database named {{database}}, then removes it. That is not this farm's database. No schedule and no off-site copy are set.
safeguards.body: This checks that a copy can be opened on this computer. How long you keep records is not decided yet.
safeguards.recoveryBody: How much data can be lost, and how long a restore may take, are not set.
safeguards.retentionBody: That decision is open. No period is stored.
safeguards.title: Spare copy
sales.body: Customers, draft orders, and prices you type. Nothing is filled in for you.
sales.duplicate: That customer name is already used.
sales.invoiceOff: A sale note is not a bill. The farm has not chosen when a sale becomes a bill.
sales.name: Name
sales.needCustomer: Add a customer before a draft order.
sales.pricesEmptyBody: The list stays empty until you type a rate. There is no default market price.
sales.title: Sales
schedules.body: Give a name to counts you want to run again. Nothing runs by itself and nothing is sent out.
schedules.emptyBody: A named report appears here after you type one.
schedules.name: Name
schedules.notSent: Nothing is sent out. No clock time is stored.
schedules.title: Saved count names
search.body: Find a name on this farm. A percent sign is an ordinary character. Prices are not shown.
search.emptyBody: Nothing on this farm matched those letters.
search.label: Words
search.title: Find a record
server.body: Type the address of the farm computer. A Tailscale address looks like https://your-computer.ts.net. A house address looks like http://192.168.1.10:5318.
server.hint: Include https:// or http://. This phone remembers it.
server.label: Computer address
server.title: Where is the farm computer?
sheds.body: Places birds will live. Capacity is a number of birds, not a veterinary limit.
sheds.emptyBody: Add a shed before later phases can record birds.
sheds.name: Shed name
sheds.title: Sheds
sheds.typeNote: Shed types are a list waiting for you to confirm. They do not set heat, medicine, or how many birds fit.
shell.offline: You are offline. Changes are not queued and will not be saved until you are back online.
stock.ageHint: Type the age yourself. The app does not calculate it from a hatch date.
stock.amountHint: Leave this blank unless you want to store an amount. It is not a stock value.
stock.body: Item names, units, and weights are what you type. Nothing is preloaded.
stock.insufficient: That quantity is more than the quantity on hand.
stock.noItems: No items yet. Add a name and the unit you count.
stock.noMatchingTarget: No target you typed for this age
stock.noStandard: There is no standard weight. A target exists only after you type the age and the weight.
stock.noValue: The number on hand is what you added minus what you used. This page does not work out a money value.
stock.testHint: A laboratory result is stored only if you type it here.
stock.title: Feed, water, and weight
stock.unitHint: Type the unit, such as kg or bag. There is no default.
stock.waterNote: This note does not set a watering schedule, and it is not a laboratory result unless you type one.
stock.yourTarget: Weight you typed for this age
suppliers.body: Write the supplier, the draft order, what arrived, the bill, and the payment. A price exists only when you type it. Receiving goods does not change stock.
suppliers.emptyBody: Add a name you use for this shop or person.
suppliers.name: Name
suppliers.noStock: Shop receipts stay on this page. Feed on hand is a separate note. No money value is worked out.
suppliers.paymentHint: A payment is its own row. It does not close a bill.
suppliers.priceHint: Leave the price blank if you are not writing one.
suppliers.title: Shops you buy from
suppliers.unitHint: Type the money unit you use. Nothing is assumed.
tasks.body: Write the work yourself. Seasonal lists start with no steps.
tasks.copiedEmpty: No checklist steps are attached to this task.
tasks.emptyBody: Add a task, or start with an empty seasonal list and write the steps.
tasks.noSchedule: Jobs are only the ones you write. The page does not make jobs from a bird's age.
tasks.noSteps: This list has no steps. Write what should be done.
tasks.noTemplates: No lists yet. Summer heat, monsoon, and winter start empty.
tasks.noteRequired: This task asks for a note when it is completed.
tasks.onlineOnly: This screen works online. Completing a task offline is not part of this farm record yet.
tasks.proof: Ask for a note when this is completed
tasks.title: Jobs
today.body: Work for {{date}}. Eggs, losses, feed, who came, and the yard book are on this page.
today.noJobs: No open job is due today.
today.title: Today
tour.group.birds: Flocks are groups of birds. Eggs and deaths hang off those flocks.
tour.group.daily: Start here each morning. Today lists jobs that are due. The yard book is where you write let-out, shut-in, and what you saw. Eggs, losses, and who came are one tap away.
tour.group.feed: What you bought and what the birds ate. You type the amounts.
tour.group.health: Named diseases and medicines from the training papers. Unchecked notes cannot record a medicine.
tour.group.help: Open this any time for the same steps, and to play this tour again.
tour.group.incubator: Machines you own, and eggs under a machine or a broody hen. The hatch day is not guessed.
tour.group.money: Sales, spending, shops, and buyer lists. Prices exist only when you type them.
tour.group.people: Add a worker with a name, a mobile number, and a short PIN, and choose what they may see.
tour.group.reports: Totals between two dates you choose.
tour.group.settings: Sheds, papers, and less common tools. You do not need these every morning.
tour.languageBody: English, Hindi, or Marathi. Hindi and Marathi still need a fluent person to review the words.
tour.pageExplain: This page is for the job in the heading. Read the short note under it.
tour.pageTap: The green button opens the form. Fill the boxes, then keep the note.
tour.saathi: Speak or type what happened. A card shows the flock, the number, and the day. Nothing is written until you tap Save.
tour.screen.batches.tap: Opens the form. The hatch day cannot be after the day you opened the flock, and neither day can be after today.
tour.screen.batches.title: A flock is birds that started together.
tour.screen.batches.why: Eggs, deaths, and feed can point at this flock later.
tour.screen.eggs.tap: Opens the form. Pick the day, then type a count for each egg name you use.
tour.screen.eggs.title: This is where collected eggs are written.
tour.screen.eggs.why: One line per collection so you can see the week later. No price is kept.
tour.screen.health.tap: Opens that name: what it is for, the signs, how the paper said to give it, and the caution.
tour.screen.health.title: These notes are diseases and medicines, one name each.
tour.screen.health.why: A worker can read the signs. Giving a medicine stays locked until someone checks the note.
tour.screen.incubators.tap: Adds a machine. Eggs you set to hatch are the other tile, Eggs set to hatch.
tour.screen.incubators.title: These are the machines, not the eggs inside them.
tour.screen.incubators.why: A reading stores only a number you typed. There is no target temperature.
tour.welcome.manager: You can run the day, birds, hatch, health, feed, and money. You cannot change who owns the farm.
tour.welcome.owner: You see every tile. Money, people, and the spare-copy check are yours. A worker will not see those.
tour.welcome.worker: You see the daily jobs: birds, eggs, hatch, health, and feed. Money and people are hidden because those are not your buttons.
validation.different: The new password must be different.
validation.future_date: This date cannot be after today.
validation.hatch_after_opened: Hatch date cannot be after the opened date.
validation.too_big: This value is too long or too large.
validation.too_small: This value is too short or too small.
workforce.body: Record who was present and which training they finished. The count of attendance rows is not a score.
workforce.dueHint: A due date may be in the future. Leave it blank if there is none.
workforce.methodHint: Type the method this farm uses. Nothing is filled in for you.
workforce.required: This task stays open until that training is finished.
workforce.rowCount: {{count}} attendance rows. This is not a score.
workforce.timeHint: Leave this blank if you do not record a clock time.
